entities.name: Paging procedure for CS fallback
entities.description: Network-initiated paging procedure for CS fallback when UE is IMSI attached for non-EPS services. Used to notify UE about incoming mobile terminating CS services.

entities.name: CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION
entities.description: Message sent by network to notify UE about incoming mobile terminating CS service when NAS signalling connection exists. May include CS service related parameters.

entities.name: EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE in response to paging for CS fallback. Contains CSFB response information element indicating accept or reject decision.

entities.name: CSFB response information element
entities.description: Information element in EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message that indicates UE's response (accept or reject) to CS fallback paging.

entities.name: Paging restriction conditions
entities.description: Conditions where network should not initiate paging for CS fallback: when MME has stored paging restriction set to 'All paging is restricted' or 'All paging is restricted except for specified PDN connection(s)'.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE
entities.description: EMM state where UE responds immediately to paging for CS fallback.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: EMM state where UE may request upper layers input before responding to CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION message.

entities.name: CSG ID list provision
entities.description: Network EMM entity may provide lower layer with list of CSG IDs during paging, except when PDN connection for emergency bearer services is established.

relations.description: CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION message is sent as part of paging procedure when NAS signalling connection exists.
UE responds to paging with EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message.
EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message contains CSFB response information element.
Paging procedure is guarded by paging restriction conditions that prevent initiation in certain cases.
Paging procedure requires UE to be in EMM-IDLE state for immediate response.
Paging procedure requires UE to be in EMM-CONNECTED state for CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION delivery.
Paging procedure establishes the property of CSG ID list provision to lower layers.
